newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Eregli exceeds 6-mth export target.
newsitem.headline: Turk Eregli exceeds 6-mth export target.

text.p: Turkey's largely state-owned flat steel producer Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari exceeded its export target by 33 percent and met its domestic sales target in the first six months of 1997, the company said.
First half production was 1,430,674 tonnes and sales were 1,427,481 tonnes, including 344,504 tonnes of exports which earned the company $110.3 million, Eregli said in a statement.

The company had planned to sell 2.85 million tonnes of products, including 500,000 tonnes of exports this year, after a record in 1996 of 2,621,000 tonnes output and 2,517,000 tonnes sales, including 502,000 tonnes of exports.

Eregli said additional investments had begun to lower costs and raise the value added to products, in addition to the $1.5 billion capacity increase and modernisation (KAM) scheme which was launched in 1989 and is almost complete.
It said spending on additional investments would be $56 million in 1997 and $152 million in the next few years.
Eregli plans to raise its annual output capacity to 3.3 million tonnes with the completion of KAM.

"As a result of negotiations between Turkey and the ECSC, Eregli's hot milling capacity was set at 4.5 million tonnes. Investments to fully utilise this capacity will be continued during the transition period," the statement said.
"Within this framework, studies of KAM 3, a new investment project, also continue," it added.
